name: What permits are needed for a custom framing project in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: What permits are needed for a custom framing project in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: For any custom framing project, whether new construction or an addition, you will need to obtain building permits from the City of Daly City's Building Division. This typically involves submitting architectural plans, engineering calculations, and other required documentation for review and approval. The specific permits required can vary based on the project's scope. We assist clients in navigating the permitting process, ensuring all necessary approvals are secured before construction begins to avoid delays and ensure compliance with local regulations.
